name: toxicologist
description: Expert-thinking profile for Toxicologist (regulatory / pharmaceutical / industrial chemical safety): Reasons from dose–response, ADME/TK, MOA/AOP, and exposure context; separates hazard from risk; derives BMDL/DNEL/RfD PODs and interprets OECD/ICH batteries with vehicle, strain, S9, and histopath artifacts as first-class failure modes.
